meta.title: Shree Udyan Ganesh
meta.institution: Shree Udyan Ganesh Mandir Seva Samiti
meta.foundedNote: A temple establishment in 1970 is consistently reported. The official homepage gives 1 March 1970, while its history page gives 9 February 1970. Discovery accounts differ between 1963 and 1966; none is silently selected.
meta.intro: A permanent Ganesh shrine beneath a banyan tree at Shivaji Park, Udyan Ganesh belongs to the everyday religious life of Dadar. Its historical record includes the move from an outdoor image to a built sanctuary, later rebuilding, and distinctive Bal Ganesh iconography. This collection preserves disagreements within the temple’s own chronology and distinguishes photographs of the enduring shrine from annually recreated festival idols.

sections.title: A 1970 foundation with two exact dates

paragraphs.text: The temple’s own history places the early image beneath a banyan tree and gives 9 February 1970, Magh Shuddha Chaturthi, as the date on which it became known as Shree Udyan Ganesh. Its homepage instead dates the temple’s establishment to 1 March 1970. Both support 1970; neither page explains whether the dates refer to different ceremonies.

Accounts of the earlier image also differ. The official homepage describes a miraculous appearance in 1963, while Mumbai Live’s Marathi history says a person found a small idol in 1966. These are attributed origin accounts, not archaeological dating. The later report says a small temple followed in 1970 and that rebuilding took place in 2012.

The official description identifies a four-armed Bal Ganesh with a right-turning trunk and attributes a conch, laddu, tusk and mace to the image. Riddhi-Siddhi and Laksha-Labh stand beside it. Maharashtra Times’ Marathi account describes a silver image, marble construction and gilded throne and dome. These describe the temple and its icon, not a new murti produced for each festival.

Mumbai Live records worship throughout the year, including Satyanarayan, Satya Vinayak, Rudra and Shodashopachar observances. Ganeshotsav is one part of that continuing calendar. Photographs dated 2006 and 2021 document different moments in the shrine’s built history; neither by itself establishes an exact rebuilding or consecration date.

A January 1983 Sai Leela report explicitly dates installation of the silver-covered Udyan Ganesh in a new white-marble sanctum to noon on 19 November 1982. Trustee Gopal Hingorani described a silver covering made from donated articles. A souvenir was released by Pandit Jasraj during the concluding programme. This dated building-and-worship event is distinct from the disputed foundation accounts and the later reported 2012 rebuilding.

The expanded record also includes a creator-dated 2021 exterior showing the illuminated temple and its covered approach. In September 2026, Sakal reported a municipal notice concerning a temporary bamboo shed in the grounds. That news report documents a dispute about additional shelter; it does not establish demolition of the temple, replacement of its icon or a final administrative outcome.

openQuestions.title: Which 1970 ceremony?
openQuestions.text: Obtain a consecration invitation, trust minutes or a dated inscription to reconcile 9 February and 1 March 1970.

openQuestions.title: Discovery and reconstruction records
openQuestions.text: Seek a period account of the pre-temple image and documentation of the reported 2012 rebuilding. Do not merge the 1963 miracle account with the 1966 discovery account.

openQuestions.text: Locate the ceremonial souvenir and original photographs or plans, distinguishing silver covering, new sanctum and later reconstruction.

claims.text: The built shrine dates to 1970, but the official pages disagree on its exact establishment day.
The idol’s miraculous appearance in 1963 is the temple homepage’s devotional account, not independently dated evidence.
Rebuilding in 2012 is reported in local Marathi coverage.
A contemporary report dates the new-sanctum installation to 19 November 1982.
The 2026 shed notice is a reported dispute; its eventual outcome is unknown.
